text:
nina: quick flag 1: QA found that when the v1 -> v2 model mapping triggers a server-side redirect, client stop sequences sometimes get ignored in streaming mode. Minimal repro attached below.

soren: can you drop the repro here? we need to triage impact.

nina: repro: `echo '{"model":"legacy/3r","input":"hi","stop":["END"]}' | curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/responses --data @- -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -i` then follow the 307 Location -> `/v2/responses?model=rwd/3r-v2` and read streamed chunks: we observed "END" tokens emitted.

docs-alex: thanks. action items: (1) update migration guide to call out streaming semantics and a short workaround; (2) add note to deprecation notice for the old models endpoint; (3) update code snippets in both TS and Python examples to prefer `rwd/*-v2` aliases.

sdk-jess: for SDKs we should add a compatibility helper: `responses.wrap_v1_for_v2(req)` that preserves stop metadata across redirects. I'll draft snippet for both SDKs.

infra-lee: runtime note: current proxy rewrites model param but doesn't copy `stop` into the new stream metadata header. We can either copy it or have the v2 runtime enforce server-side stop when requested. Copying is easier but needs test coverage.

legal-ash: legal wants 30 days notice on breaking behavioral changes. If we change runtime behavior that might affect existing contracts, we need to coordinate legal + product comms.

ci-bot: New CI job created: docs-smoke/stopseq-checker (runs nightly) :white_check_mark:

nina: timeline proposal: patch redirect behavior in infra this week (lee), land SDK compatibility helper next week (jess), docs patches + deprecation banner scheduled after infra patch but with 30 days notice (alex/marketing).

docs-alex: I'll open a docs PR with three edits: migration guide (section "Streaming differences when routed to v2 models"), a short FAQ item, and updated examples under /examples/migration. PR link will be posted here.

sdk-jess: also adding unit tests in sdk repo to validate `stop` persists when using `client.responses.stream` across a simulated redirect.

infra-lee: quick workaround we can call out in docs: include server-side stop override param `x-rwd-force-stop: true` in v1 requests to ensure backend enforces stop if client-provided stop is lost. We'll gate it behind a feature flag.

nina: good. docs should show both preferred fix (use v2 alias directly) and the emergency workaround header.

docs-alex: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/501 (WIP) 1: includes examples, FAQ, and deprecation banner draft.

legal-ash: I'll prepare a short legal note confirming 30-day notice is satisfied if we publish the banner now and set the deprecation date in 30+ days. Share wording with me before merge.

sdk-jess: posting example snippets in thread to help copy into PR: 

Python: 
```
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
for chunk in c.responses.stream(model="rwd/3r-v2", input="hi", stop=["END"]):
    print(chunk.text, end="")
```

TS: 
```
import Redwood from "@redwood/sdk"
const c = new Redwood()
for await (const chunk of c.responses.stream({model: "rwd/3r-v2", input: "hi", stop: ["END"]})) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.text)
}
```

docs-alex: nice, I'll adapt these and add the workaround header example.

nina: blue/green deploy of the infra change requested; lee can you coordinate with eng-oncall for a low-traffic window?

infra-lee: yes, scheduling for Friday 02:00 UTC; I'll post in eng-oncall and incidents channels.

docs-alex: once infra change is live, I'll update the migration guide to prefer `rwd/*-v2` in all streaming snippets and add a short note about the header fallback with a code example.

sdk-jess: will cut a tiny patch release for SDKs (patch bump) that includes the compatibility helper and snippet updates. ETA next Tuesday.

legal-ash: please add a sentence to the deprecation banner: "We plan to retire the legacy models endpoint behavior on YYYY-MM-DD. Please migrate to the v2 aliases; see migration guide for streaming caveats." I'll propose final date after infra confirms rollout.

nina: thanks everyone. tagging follow-ups: docs-alex (PR + banner copy), infra-lee (proxy change + smoke test), sdk-jess (compat helper + releases), legal-ash (banner approval).

docs-alex: will update thread with PR link and checklist once CI passes.

ci-bot: docs-smoke/stopseq-checker passed on staging :white_check_mark:

nina: perfect. I'll re-run the repro after infra patch and paste logs here.

soren: thanks all. Keeping this thread as the single source of truth for this migration/deprecation coordination.
